# Prerequisites {.unnumbered}

> "You can't build a great building on a weak foundation. You must have a solid foundation if you're going to have a strong superstructure." --- Gordon B. Hinckley    

> "Success is neither magical nor mysterious. Success is the natural consequence of consistently applying the basic fundamentals." --- Jim Rohn  

> "Get the fundamentals down and the level of everything you do will rise." --- Michael Jordan  

> "If you have built castles in the air, your work need not be lost; that is where they should be. Now put the foundations under them." --- Henry David Thoreau  



Bioinformatics is a multidisciplinary field of study. Based on your goals and backgrounds, you will choose different paths. You can go through each chapter and explore resources for yourself. We recommend you to learn the basic level of each fundamental, and then start to delve into advanced resources and special topics.
